item.title: A reminder winter is not over this weekend into early next week | Feb. 20, 2026
item.description: After a severe weather Thursday, Indiana is expecting colder and windy conditions this weekend with snow potential, and temperatures will remain in the low 40s and 30s through Monday.

item.title: Kenneth Johnson pleads not guilty to murder of Beech Grove police officer
item.description: Kenneth Johnson, 47, has been charged with murder, attempted murder, criminal confinement, and domestic battery after allegedly shooting and killing 33-year-old Brian Elliott and wounding his partner during a disturbance call at a Beech Grove apartment complex.

item.title: Procession route announced for Officer Elliott’s Celebration of Life Ceremony
item.description: The procession route was announced for Officer Brian Elliott's Celebration of Life Ceremony. The public Celebration of Life Ceremony and procession will be held Feb. 23, 2026. A public visitation is scheduled a day earlier at Beech Grove High School. The Beech Grove Police Department officer was fatally shot while responding to a domestic call.

item.title: Former Indiana lawmakers say Bears move to Hoosier state increasingly likely
item.description: Members of News 8's "All INdiana Politics" panel say Thursday's announcement by the Chicago Bears makes a team move to Indiana increasingly likely.

item.title: How likely is the Chicago Bears move to happen at this point? IU sports media director weighs in
item.description: The passage of Senate Bill 27 by the House Ways and Means Committee has created a pathway to build a stadium and potentially bring the Chicago Bears to northwest Indiana.

item.title: Parents accused in daughter’s neglect death say she was ‘problematic,’ ‘attention-seeking’
item.description: Kenneth and Elba Vazquez were arrested and charged with neglect of a dependent resulting in death after their 11-year-old daughter was found unresponsive in their home, with evidence suggesting years of abuse and neglect.

item.title: THE ZONE: Scores and Highlights – February 20, 2026
item.description: "The Zone" featured highlights from nine high school boys basketball games across central Indiana on Friday, including Pike at Lawrence North, Fishers at Zionsville, and more.

item.title: #7 Purdue puts hammer down on Indiana, beating Hoosiers 93-64
item.description: WEST LAFAYETTE, Ind. (WISH) — As the saying goes, No. 7 Purdue put the hammer down on rival Indiana Friday night, beating the Hoosiers 93-64. item.title: 2 juveniles die, 2 others hurt when pickup strikes horse-drawn cart
item.description: Two juveniles were killed and two others seriously injured when a pickup collided with a horse-drawn cart in Elkhart County, Indiana, the sheriff's office reports.

item.title: Bloomington residents clean up after tornado, severe storms
item.description: Severe storms caused extensive damage to Bloomington and surrounding counties, including a Fifth Third Bank, a Kia dealership, and the Monroe County Humane Society, with potential tornado damage reported in the area.
